@'
import json
for f in ["network_presets/fragments/discussion.json","network_presets/fragments/execution.json"]:
    d=json.load(open(f,encoding="utf-8"))["network"]
    print("==",f)
    print("repeat_unit_count",d.get("repeat_unit_count"))
    ru=d.get("repeat_unit")
    print("repeat_unit type",type(ru).__name__, (list(ru.keys()) if isinstance(ru,dict) else len(ru)))
    for n in d["nodes"]:
        print(" node",n.get("node_id"),n.get("name"),"type",n.get("type"),"links",[l.get("target_id") for l in n.get("links",[])])
        print("   modules",[m.get("module_id") for m in n.get("tables",{}).get("modules",[])])
    print(" props",json.dumps(d.get("properties"),ensure_ascii=False)[:400])
'@ | python -
